description: This file is the main entry point for a Vue.js frontend application. It imports essential styling and script modules, initializes the Vue app, and sets up plugins such as Pinia (state management) and Vue Router for routing. Finally, it mounts the app to the DOM element with id 'app'.

methods.name: createApp
methods.description: Creates a new Vue application instance with the root component 'App'.

methods.name: app.use
methods.description: Registers plugins with the Vue app instance, such as Pinia for state management and the Router for navigation.

methods.name: app.mount
methods.description: Mounts the Vue app to the DOM element with the specified selector ('#app').
